title: 20 oz double walled stainless
text: 20 oz double walled stainless. Purchased this because it would fit in my car cup holder.  It is a 20 oz mug, so not huge. I don't use for hot drinks, mostly iced water.  It does a pretty good job keeping the water cold for a few hours in a hot car.  I hand wash them (I purchased 2).  The lids are easy to remove, pull off.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: TOMIC 20 oz Double Wall Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Tumbler with Clear Lid. Keep Drinks Hot and Cold. Resistant to stains and odors, sweat & BPA Free (Brushed Stainless)
